units.source_text: 位事过后，女人以大姐的口气给我以感伤式的训诫。

en.t: After that incident was over, the woman gave me a sentimental admonition in the tone of an elder sister.

units.source_text: 这种训诫把我一瞬间仅有的感兴扫得荡然无存。

en.t: That kind of admonition swept away without a trace the only feeling of interest I had had for that brief moment.
